suggestions.title: “… not three more people moving in to help with the rent …”
suggestions.where: The inner child, the guards, and the inner adult’s three jobs, P2

edits.before: Here I’m going to talk about what you develop in yourself as you reparent your inner child. I’m going to talk about it in terms of three jobs: your loving Nurturer, your safe Adult Protector (hereafter just the Protector) and your wise Guide. That’s one grown-up doing three jobs, not three more people moving in to help with the rent, and each job keeps the others in balance. It’s you that needs to develop these qualities.
edits.after: Here I’m going to talk about what you develop in yourself as you reparent your inner child. I’m going to talk about it in terms of three jobs: your loving Nurturer, your safe Adult Protector (hereafter just the Protector) and your wise Guide. That’s one grown-up doing three jobs, not three more people moving in to help with the rent, and each job keeps the others in balance. Say a party gets to be too much for your little one. The Protector gets you both out of there, and on the way home the Nurturer tells them they did great, even though mostly they hid in the bathroom. And the Guide helps them think twice about the next weird party they might go to, avoiding another cycle of bathroom vacationing. 🙈 It’s you that needs to develop these qualities.

suggestions.title: Appendix E’s prayer to the subconscious
suggestions.where: Appendix E: Is the daydream helping or replacing your life?, P5

edits.before: If it is taking you away from life, then change your body position by sitting upright, open your eyes, feel your feet and ask your subconscious to help you. Simply say to yourself, “Dear subconscious, thank you for showing me images. If what you are showing me is helpful, then please also show me the guidance in it. If what you are showing me is a way of avoiding dealing with life, then please show me in a gentle but structured way how to deal with life as it is right now.”
edits.after: If it is taking you away from life, then change your body position by sitting upright, open your eyes, feel your feet and ask your subconscious to help you.
